import pandas as pd
from scipy.spatial.distance import pdist
c=pd.read_csv('counts.tsv',sep='\t',index_col=0)
s=pd.read_csv('samples.csv')
h=s[s.depth_cm<142].sample
ids=list(s[s.depth_cm<142]['sample'])
m=pdist(c.loc[ids].values,'braycurtis').mean()
print(ids,m)
import json
json.dump({"status":"completed_with_assumptions","results":{"mean_bray_curtis":float(m),"n_samples":len(ids)},

"exclusions":[{"id":i,"reason":"Pleistocene (depth >= 143 cm)"} for i in s[s.depth_cm>=142]['sample']],
